subject: Pilot holdout: request for extension & temporary credits due to integration blocker
messages:
From: Asha Kapoor <asha@brightlane.ai>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@brightlane.ai
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Request: pilot extension & temporary credits — integration blocker

Hi Jonas,

Quick context: our engineering team hit an unexpected blocker with the webhook handshake for Redwood's connector. The error surface is attached (error_trace.txt) — it looks like the auth header is being stripped in our staging NAT/proxy. Our SREs are investigating but estimate ~10 business days before a safe fix. That pushes our planned demo with product leadership out by ~2 weeks.

We’ve been making good progress otherwise and the PM/product team still want to move forward, but we need more runway in the sandbox to complete the validation. Can Redwood provide a two-week extension on the pilot and a temporary top-up of 25k tokens (or a sandbox credit equivalent) so we can finish the integration and not lose momentum? Procurement also asked whether there’s any standard amendment or short SOW for this kind of extension.

Attachment: error_trace.txt (text/plain)

Appreciate any help — we’re excited about moving to a production pilot once this handshake is resolved.

Best,
Asha Kapoor
Head of Product, BrightLane
asha@brightlane.ai

From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Kapoor <asha@brightlane.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, dev.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2027 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: pilot extension & temporary credits — integration blocker

Thanks for the note and the trace, Asha — sorry to hear about the NAT/proxy issue.

Marissa (CS) and Dev (solutions eng) — looped you both in to assess options. High level, we can usually support short trial extensions and a sandbox top-up while teams are blocked on non-Redwood issues. I want to confirm the ask so we’re aligned: BrightLane is requesting a two-week extension on the pilot window and a 25k-token credit to cover the extended testing. Procurement is asking for a short amendment — happy to share a one-page terms doc once we align.

Asha, quick questions for the engineering team to help Dev scope:
- Is the proxy behaviour repro'able in your staging, or only in the customer environment?
- Any ETA from SRE on the root-cause or a mitigation (10 business days OK from your standpoint)?

I’ll pause here — Marissa, Dev, can you confirm feasibility and whether we need an approvals path for the credit?

Thanks,
Jonas
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: dev.patel@redwood.ai, david.kim@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: pilot extension & temporary credits — integration blocker

Jonas / team — thanks for the heads-up. I reviewed BrightLane's usage pattern and the current pilot burn rate; they’re within typical ranges and the pilot has strong product engagement (several routes instrumented).

Operational recommendation: we can approve a time-limited runway extension and a token top-up, on the following terms:
- 14 calendar day extension from current pilot end date
- 25,000 free token credit applied to their sandbox environment
- Condition: extension contingent on BrightLane acknowledging the RCA timeline and committing weekly check-ins while the SRE team works the fix

Approvals path: this is within CS discretionary up to 30k tokens; I’ll mark the HubSpot deal BL-2027-0592 and draft a short amendment. We should attach a simple one-page terms PDF to the customer conversation (I’ll prepare that).

David — can you confirm the sandbox provisioning piece (we may need to bump their quota and temporarily pin a faster worker for the demo window)?

Marissa Cole
Sr Manager, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: dev.patel@redwood.ai <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: david.kim@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: pilot extension & temporary credits — integration blocker

Copying my notes from the quick sync with BrightLane engineers this morning:
- Repro: yes — the auth header is being rewritten by their staging proxy (they shared the same trace).
- Root cause & fix: requires change to proxy config + a small client-side shim for retry/forwarding. We estimate 6-9 business days for SRE + engineering to validate end-to-end, plus 1-2 days for our engagement/testing.
- Sandbox impact: we can add the 25k token top-up and temporarily increase their worker count for demo runs; no infra approval needed for the short bump.

I recommend the 14-day extension and 25k tokens as proposed. If procurement needs a formal document, we can attach the one-page amendment; otherwise we can proceed with an email-ack and apply the tokens.

Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.ai

From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Kapoor <asha@brightlane.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, dev.patel@redwood.ai, david.kim@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: pilot extension & temporary credits — integration blocker

Asha — good news. We’ve approved a 14-calendar-day extension to your pilot and a one-time 25,000-token sandbox credit to tide you over while SRE lands the fix. Dev will provision the sandbox bump today and Marissa will send a one-page amendment/terms doc for procurement to sign.

Terms (summary):
- Extension: +14 days from your current pilot end date
- Credit: 25,000 tokens applied to your sandbox environment (non-refundable; applied only to pilot/testing)
- Check-ins: weekly short syncs while the fix is in progress

Next steps for BrightLane: please reply to confirm you accept the above terms; procurement can either sign the attached one-page amendment or reply-all with approval. I attached the draft terms for your review.

Attachment: trial_extension_terms.pdf

We’ll hold the sandbox quota for you and stand by to help validate once the proxy change is rolled. Hang in there — we want to make sure the demo lands with the right signal.

Thanks,
Jonas
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
